research_question: Why do leaves change color in autumn?

sources.title: Why Do Leaves Change Colors in the Fall
sources.reliability: U.S. government parks and natural science agency
notes: Shorter days and changing temperatures lead to chlorophyll breakdown; yellow and orange pigments become visible as green fades.

sources.title: Fall Colors
notes: Carotenoids contribute yellows and oranges, while anthocyanins can create reds and purples; weather and species influence intensity.

sources.title: Autumn leaf color
sources.reliability: University research and public education resource
notes: Leaf color depends on pigment chemistry, species and environmental conditions; not all trees show the same colors or timing.
